decisions.subject: carrierClaim
decisions.recommended_policy: Require a carrier to differ from the claim it carries, including sameAs aliases.
decisions.implementation_or_evidence: Proposed irreflexive OWL predicate plus tag-independent SHACL shape.
decisions.limit: Do not infer that SourceRecord and Assertion are globally disjoint classes.

decisions.subject: pvResultSignal
decisions.recommended_policy: An assessment conclusion differs from the signal it evaluates.
decisions.implementation_or_evidence: Proposed irreflexive OWL predicate plus tag-independent SHACL shape.
decisions.limit: Do not create disjoint SignalKind/ResultKind just to silence BinOver; cross-context proposition reuse remains possible.

decisions.subject: caseIdentifier
decisions.recommended_policy: Case identifier identifies a scoped case reference; multiple carriers and evolving propositions may share it.
decisions.implementation_or_evidence: No OWL hasKey or inverse-functional identity axiom.
decisions.limit: Identifier scheme and reporting context are needed; not E2B message conformance.

decisions.subject: claimText
decisions.recommended_policy: Lexical equality is insufficient to infer propositional identity.
decisions.implementation_or_evidence: Two distinct claims with identical text remain consistent.
decisions.limit: A full intensional identity criterion is pending.

decisions.subject: reportsRecord
decisions.recommended_policy: Reporting event is distinct from its output record and the assertions carried by that record.
decisions.implementation_or_evidence: Retain separate event, SourceRecord and Assertion links.
decisions.limit: Complete ICSR content/message ontology remains out of this bounded profile.

decisions.subject: pvResultAssessment
decisions.recommended_policy: Status/conclusion is contextual to an assessment, assessor and time.
decisions.implementation_or_evidence: Use result-to-assessment link and assessment attribution.
decisions.limit: Do not collapse changing conclusions into timeless truth or infer causality from a signal.

decisions.subject: citesSourceRecord
decisions.recommended_policy: Citation is not by itself evidential support or truth.
decisions.implementation_or_evidence: Reuse EvidenceSupport where evidential grounding is asserted.
decisions.limit: No automatic supported/true claim inference from citation.

decisions.subject: withinCountry/withinRegion
decisions.recommended_policy: Preserve existing accepted no-self and cycle constraints.
decisions.implementation_or_evidence: No geography edit in this package.
decisions.limit: Structural BinOver trigger remains; source-specific nesting and identity still require context.
decisions.author_acceptance: prior bounded geography decision retained; no new acceptance requested

decisions.subject: serviceCapability/capabilityRealizedIn
decisions.recommended_policy: Capability can exist without a recorded realization; specification is not execution.
decisions.limit: Do not raise global lower bounds to make the graph look connected.
